en: Amy finished her science project by herself last weekend.
exzh: Amy 上週末獨自完成了她的科學專題。
note: oneself 依主詞變化：myself、himself、herself 等

en: Our school library is open from eight to five on weekdays.
exzh: 我們學校圖書館平日從八點開到五點。

en: Ben likes fruit such as bananas, apples, and grapes.
exzh: Ben 喜歡香蕉、蘋果和葡萄這類水果。
note: 後接名詞舉例，意思同 like

en: Kevin is as tall as his older brother now.
exzh: Kevin 現在和他哥哥一樣高。
note: as + 形容詞／副詞原級 + as；否定 not as...as

en: We have to wear school uniforms every Monday and Friday.
exzh: 我們每週一和週五都必須穿制服。
note: 否定 don't have to＝不必

en: The bus stop is between the bakery and the post office.
exzh: 公車站在麵包店和郵局之間。

en: Mia was so tired that she fell asleep on the bus.
exzh: Mia 累到在公車上睡著了。
note: so + 形容詞／副詞 + that 子句

en: Both Leo and Tom joined the basketball club this year.
exzh: Leo 和 Tom 今年都加入了籃球社。
note: 當主詞時動詞用複數

en: Lisa was able to finish the math test on time.
exzh: Lisa 能準時寫完數學考試。
note: 可用於各種時態，如 will be able to

en: Ken got up early so that he could catch the first bus.
exzh: Ken 早起，好趕上第一班公車。
note: 後接子句，常與 can／could 連用

en: Emma studies hard every night in order to pass the test.
exzh: 為了通過考試，Emma 每晚都用功讀書。
note: 後接原形動詞；in order not to＝為了不

en: Our new English teacher comes from a small town in Canada.
exzh: 我們的新英文老師來自加拿大的一個小鎮。

en: Tom used to walk to school, but now he rides a bike.
exzh: Tom 以前都走路上學，但現在騎腳踏車。
note: 勿與 be used to + V-ing（習慣於）混淆

en: Amy and Lisa help each other with homework after school.
exzh: Amy 和 Lisa 放學後互相幫忙寫作業。

en: Ben is not only good at math but also great at sports.
exzh: Ben 不只數學好，運動也很強。
note: 連接主詞時，動詞與 but also 後的主詞一致

en: Kevin stayed home from school because of a bad cold.
exzh: Kevin 因為重感冒沒去上學，待在家裡。
note: because of 接名詞；because 接子句

en: Kevin did not go to bed until midnight last night.
exzh: Kevin 昨晚直到半夜才上床睡覺。

en: Please go on with your story; we all want to hear it.
exzh: 請繼續說你的故事，我們都想聽。
note: go on + V-ing／with sth.＝繼續做

en: Mia wants to find out why her phone keeps shutting down.
exzh: Mia 想查出她的手機為什麼一直關機。

en: People all over the world love Taiwanese bubble tea.
exzh: 世界各地的人都很愛台灣的珍珠奶茶。
note: 同 around the world

en: You can either take the bus or ride your bike to school.
exzh: 你可以搭公車或騎腳踏車上學。
note: 連接主詞時，動詞與 or 後的主詞一致

en: Leo drank water instead of soda after the soccer game.
exzh: Leo 踢完足球後喝水，而不是喝汽水。
note: 後接名詞或 V-ing

en: Some students like to read, and others like to play basketball.
exzh: 有些學生喜歡閱讀，有些則喜歡打籃球。
note: 指全部時用 some...the others...

en: It was such a hot day that we stayed inside all afternoon.
exzh: 那天實在太熱，我們整個下午都待在室內。
note: such + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that

en: Lisa and I arrived at the classroom at the same time.
exzh: Lisa 和我同時抵達教室。

en: Dad will come back from his business trip on Sunday.
exzh: 爸爸星期天出差回來。
note: come back from + 地點

en: Mom will pick me up at the train station at six.
exzh: 媽媽六點會到火車站接我。
note: 受詞是代名詞要放中間：pick me up

en: The number of students in our club has grown this year.
exzh: 我們社團的學生人數今年增加了。
note: 動詞用單數；a number of 接複數動詞

en: Taiwanese breakfast is very different from American breakfast.
exzh: 台灣的早餐和美國的早餐非常不同。
note: 名詞 difference

en: Ken waited for his friends in front of the movie theater.
exzh: Ken 在電影院前面等他的朋友。
note: in the front of＝在⋯⋯內部的前方

en: A number of students joined the beach cleanup last Saturday.
exzh: 上週六有許多學生參加了淨灘活動。
note: 後接複數名詞與複數動詞

en: Emma dreams of becoming a nurse and helping sick people.
exzh: Emma 夢想成為護理師，幫助生病的人。
note: 後接名詞或 V-ing

en: Tom tried stinky tofu for the first time at the night market.
exzh: Tom 在夜市第一次吃臭豆腐。

en: My phone rang in the middle of the English class.
exzh: 我的手機在英文課上到一半時響了。

en: Look at the beautiful rainbow over the mountains, Ben!
exzh: Ben，你看山上那道美麗的彩虹！
note: look 強調看的動作；see 強調看到

en: Amy has lots of homework to finish before Monday.
exzh: Amy 星期一前有很多作業要寫完。
note: 可接可數或不可數名詞，同 a lot of

en: More and more students use their phones to study English.
exzh: 越來越多學生用手機學英文。

en: Leo searched for his lost keys all over the house.
exzh: Leo 在家裡到處找他弄丟的鑰匙。
note: search + 地點＝搜查某地

en: I cannot think of a good name for our club.
exzh: 我想不出我們社團的好名字。
note: What do you think of...?＝你認為⋯⋯如何？

en: Don't worry about the test; you studied very hard.
exzh: 別擔心考試，你已經很用功了。

en: Mia ate a piece of chocolate cake after dinner.
exzh: Mia 晚餐後吃了一塊巧克力蛋糕。
note: 常接不可數名詞：a piece of paper／advice

en: Dad drinks a cup of hot coffee every morning.
exzh: 爸爸每天早上喝一杯熱咖啡。
note: 複數加在 cup：two cups of

en: Mango shaved ice is a kind of dessert that is very popular in Taiwan.
exzh: 芒果冰是一種在台灣很受歡迎的甜點。

en: The field trip bus arrived at the zoo at nine.
exzh: 校外教學的遊覽車九點到達動物園。
note: 大地點用 arrive in

en: Ken talks as if he knows everything about computers.
exzh: Ken 說話的樣子好像他對電腦無所不知。
note: 同 as though

en: I didn't understand the math problem at all.
exzh: 我完全看不懂那道數學題。
note: 常用於否定句 not...at all

en: Lisa stayed at home all weekend because she had a cold.
exzh: Lisa 因為感冒，整個週末都待在家。
note: feel at home＝感到自在

en: We have a big test at the end of this month.
exzh: 我們這個月底有一場大考。
note: in the end＝最後

en: The top of the mountain was covered with snow last winter.
exzh: 去年冬天山頂覆蓋著白雪。

en: Tainan is famous for its delicious local snacks.
exzh: 台南以美味的在地小吃聞名。
note: be famous as＝以⋯⋯身分聞名

en: Ben is interested in basketball, so he joined the school team.
exzh: Ben 對籃球感興趣，所以他加入了校隊。
note: in 後接名詞或 V-ing；interested 形容人，interesting 形容事物

en: Tainan is known for its delicious snacks and old temples.
exzh: 台南以美味的小吃和古老的廟宇聞名。
note: 同義：be famous for

en: This sweet drink is made from fresh mangoes and milk.
exzh: 這杯甜飲是用新鮮芒果和牛奶做成的。
note: 易混淆：be made of 看得出原料

en: We are supposed to hand in our reports by Friday.
exzh: 我們應該在星期五之前交報告。
note: to 後接原形動詞

en: This red umbrella belongs to Lisa, not to me.
exzh: 這把紅色的雨傘是 Lisa 的，不是我的。
note: 不用進行式，也沒有被動語態

en: Come on, Kevin! You can finish the race!
exzh: 加油，Kevin！你一定能跑完比賽！

en: Mia always does her best on every math test.
exzh: Mia 每次數學考試都盡全力。
note: one's 要依主詞換成 my、his、her 等

en: First of all, please turn off your phones before class starts.
exzh: 首先，請在上課前把手機關機。
note: 常放句首，後面加逗號

en: Amy and Emma have been good friends for a long time.
exzh: Amy 和 Emma 當好朋友已經很久了。
note: 常搭配現在完成式

en: Don't give up on English, even if it seems hard now.
exzh: 就算英文現在看起來很難，也不要放棄。
note: give up + V-ing：放棄做某事

en: We had fun at the beach with our classmates last weekend.
exzh: 上週末我們和同學在海邊玩得很開心。
note: 同義：have a good time

en: Tom often helps his little sister with her homework after dinner.
exzh: Tom 晚餐後常幫妹妹寫功課。
note: 也可說 help sb. (to) + 原形動詞

en: Students waited in line to buy lunch at the school store.
exzh: 學生們排隊在福利社買午餐。
note: 常見搭配：wait in line、stand in line

en: Please don't talk loudly on your phone in public.
exzh: 請不要在公共場合大聲講電話。
note: 反義：in private 私下

en: Leo wants to become a doctor in the future.
exzh: Leo 將來想當醫生。

en: Ken got to the station just in time for the last train.
exzh: Ken 剛好及時趕到車站，搭上最後一班火車。
note: 易混淆：on time 準時

en: My cousin lives on two hundred dollars a day at college.
exzh: 我表哥在大學每天靠兩百元過生活。

en: Lisa looked up the new words on her phone.
exzh: Lisa 用手機查了那些新單字。
note: 受詞是代名詞時要放中間：look it up

en: Kevin was not tired at all after the long hike.
exzh: 走了很長的山路後，Kevin 一點也不累。

en: Amy has two cats; one is white, and the other is black.
exzh: Amy 養了兩隻貓，一隻是白的，另一隻是黑的。
note: 只用於兩者；三者時用 one...another...the other...

en: We have plenty of time, so let's walk to the station.
exzh: 我們時間還很充裕，所以走路去車站吧。
note: 可接可數或不可數名詞

en: Ben didn't show up for club practice yesterday afternoon.
exzh: Ben 昨天下午沒有出現在社團練習。
note: 同義：turn up

en: Please slow down, Mia! The floor is wet after the rain.
exzh: Mia，慢一點！下過雨地板很濕。
note: 反義：speed up 加速

en: Emma has a bad cold, so she takes medicine three times a day.
exzh: Emma 得了重感冒，所以她一天吃三次藥。
note: 「吃藥」用 take，不用 eat

en: Please take off your shoes before you go into Grandma's house.
exzh: 進奶奶家之前請先把鞋子脫掉。
note: 反義：put on 穿上

en: I usually wake up at six thirty on school days.
exzh: 上學日我通常六點半醒來。
note: wake up 醒來，get up 起床

en: Kevin is responsible for cleaning the classroom windows this week.
exzh: Kevin 這星期負責擦教室的窗戶。
note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing

en: The little dog ran away when it heard the loud thunder.
exzh: 小狗聽到很大的雷聲就跑走了。
note: run away from：從⋯⋯逃走

en: Tom gets up early to run in the park every morning.
exzh: Tom 每天早上很早起床去公園跑步。
note: 易混淆：wake up 醒來

en: Lisa bought a pair of new running shoes for gym class.
exzh: Lisa 為了體育課買了一雙新的跑鞋。
note: 常見搭配：a pair of shoes／glasses／pants

en: After a while, the rain stopped and we went outside to play.
exzh: 過了一會兒，雨停了，我們就到外面玩。

en: My little brother plays games on his phone all the time.
exzh: 我弟弟一天到晚都在用手機玩遊戲。
note: 同義：always

en: At the night market, we ate fried chicken, noodles, and so on.
exzh: 在夜市，我們吃了炸雞、麵等等。
note: 放在列舉的最後

en: Our class will arrive in Hualien around noon tomorrow.
exzh: 我們班明天中午左右會抵達花蓮。
note: 小地方用 arrive at

en: At first, Mia was shy, but now she talks to everyone.
exzh: 一開始 Mia 很害羞，但現在她跟每個人都會聊天。
note: 易混淆：first of all 首先（列點）

en: High school life is different from junior high life in many ways.
exzh: 高中生活在很多方面都和國中生活不同。
note: 反義：be the same as

en: This old desk is made of wood from my grandpa's farm.
exzh: 這張舊書桌是用我爺爺農場的木頭做的。
note: 易混淆：be made from 看不出原料

en: Ben is ready for the English test tomorrow morning.
exzh: Ben 已經準備好明天早上的英文考試了。
note: be ready to + 原形動詞：準備好做某事

en: Emma's school uniform is similar to the uniform at my school.
exzh: Emma 學校的制服和我們學校的很像。
note: 反義：be different from

en: Everyone was surprised at the size of the birthday cake.
exzh: 大家都對生日蛋糕的大小感到驚訝。
note: surprised 形容人，surprising 形容事物

en: Leo is worried about his math grade this semester.
exzh: Leo 很擔心他這學期的數學成績。
note: 同義：worry about

zh: 相信（⋯⋯的能力或存在）；信仰
en: Ken believes in himself, so he never stops practicing the guitar.
exzh: Ken 相信自己，所以他從不停止練吉他。
note: believe sb. 相信某人說的話

en: Our school bus broke down on the way to the museum.
exzh: 我們的校車在去博物館的路上拋錨了。

en: By the way, did you finish the science project, Amy?
exzh: 對了，Amy，你自然科的專題做完了嗎？
note: 用來轉換話題，常縮寫為 BTW

en: After the party, we helped Mom clean up the living room.
exzh: 派對結束後，我們幫媽媽把客廳打掃乾淨。

en: Kevin practiced the piano day and night before the contest.
exzh: 比賽前 Kevin 日以繼夜地練鋼琴。

en: Lisa does the dishes every night after her family eats dinner.
exzh: Lisa 每晚在家人吃完晚餐後洗碗。
note: 同義：wash the dishes

en: Tom fell asleep in class because he stayed up too late.
exzh: Tom 因為太晚睡，上課時睡著了。
note: fall 的過去式是 fell

en: I don't feel like going out because it's raining so hard.
exzh: 雨下得好大，我不想出門。
note: feel like + V-ing：想做某事

en: Please fill out this form before you join the photography club.
exzh: 加入攝影社之前請先填寫這張表格。
note: 同義：fill in

en: Amy gets along with everyone in her class, so she has many friends.
exzh: Amy 和班上每個人都處得很好，所以她有很多朋友。
note: get along well with 相處得很好

en: Ben studied hard every night because he wanted to get into a good college.
exzh: Ben 每晚都很用功，因為他想考上一所好大學。
note: get into trouble 惹上麻煩

en: My older sister will get married to her boyfriend next spring.
exzh: 我姊姊明年春天要和她男朋友結婚。
note: 和某人結婚：get married to sb.（不用 with）

en: Lisa got on the bus to school at seven o'clock this morning.
exzh: Lisa 今天早上七點搭上去學校的公車。
note: 反義：get off 下車；上汽車用 get into

en: Kevin got out of bed late and missed his first class.
exzh: Kevin 太晚起床，錯過了第一堂課。
note: 反義：get into

en: Mia left her phone in the classroom, so she had to go back.
exzh: Mia 把手機忘在教室，所以她必須回去拿。
note: go back to + 地點；回家 go back home

en: After dinner, Ken and his dog often go for a walk in the park.
exzh: 晚餐後，Ken 常常帶著他的狗去公園散步。
note: 同義：take a walk

en: Emma and her mother like to go shopping at the night market on weekends.
exzh: Emma 和她媽媽週末喜歡去夜市逛街。
note: 同類：go swimming、go hiking

en: Tom grew up in a small town in Hualien with his grandparents.
exzh: Tom 是和祖父母在花蓮的一個小鎮長大的。
note: grow up 不接受詞；養育孩子用 bring up

en: We had a good time at the beach during the summer vacation.
exzh: 暑假期間我們在海邊玩得很開心。
note: 同義：have fun、enjoy oneself

en: The food was cold and the service was slow. In short, it was terrible.
exzh: 食物是冷的，服務又慢。總之，糟透了。
note: 同義：in a word、in brief

en: Leo kept on practicing basketball even though it started to rain.
exzh: 即使開始下雨，Leo 還是繼續練習籃球。
note: keep on + V-ing

en: Please don't laugh at Amy when she makes a mistake in English class.
exzh: Amy 在英文課上犯錯時，請不要嘲笑她。
note: make fun of 也有嘲笑之意

en: Ben looks like his father, especially when he smiles.
exzh: Ben 長得很像他爸爸，尤其是他笑的時候。
note: look like + 名詞；look + 形容詞

en: Lisa wants to lose weight, so she goes jogging every morning.
exzh: Lisa 想減重，所以她每天早上去慢跑。
note: 反義：gain weight／put on weight 增重

en: Neither Kevin nor his brother likes to eat vegetables at dinner.
exzh: Kevin 和他弟弟晚餐時都不喜歡吃蔬菜。
note: 動詞與 nor 後的主詞一致；反義：both...and...

en: No matter what happens, Mia always tries her best in every game.
exzh: 無論發生什麼事，Mia 在每場比賽中總是全力以赴。
note: = whatever；另有 no matter who／where／how

en: "Can I borrow your pen?" Ken asked. "Of course," Emma said with a smile.
exzh: 「我可以借你的筆嗎？」Ken 問。「當然可以。」Emma 笑著說。
note: 同義：sure、certainly

en: Tom passes by a bakery on his way to school every morning.
exzh: Tom 每天早上上學途中都會經過一家麵包店。
note: 時間流逝也可用 pass by

en: Mom asked Leo to put away his toys before the guests arrived.
exzh: 媽媽要 Leo 在客人到之前把玩具收好。
note: 代名詞放中間：put it away

en: This song always reminds Amy of her happy days in junior high.
exzh: 這首歌總是讓 Amy 想起她國中時快樂的日子。
note: 提醒某人做某事：remind sb. to V

en: The coach shouted at Ben because he was late for practice again.
exzh: 教練對 Ben 大吼，因為他練習又遲到了。
note: shout at 帶怒氣；shout to 只是大聲喊讓對方聽見

en: Lisa spends two hours on her homework every night after dinner.
exzh: Lisa 每天晚餐後花兩個小時寫功課。
note: spend + 時間 + V-ing；主詞是人，比較 It takes...

en: Kevin stayed up late to study for the math test last night.
exzh: Kevin 昨晚熬夜準備數學考試。
note: stay up late 熬夜

en: Mia takes care of her little brother when her parents are at work.
exzh: 爸媽上班時，Mia 會照顧她的弟弟。
note: 同義：look after

en: Ken took out his phone and showed us the photos from the trip.
exzh: Ken 拿出手機，給我們看旅行的照片。
note: take out the trash 倒垃圾

en: At lunch, Emma and her friends like to talk about their favorite shows.
exzh: 午餐時，Emma 和朋友們喜歡聊她們最愛的節目。
note: 比較：talk to 和某人說話

en: If you feel sad, you can always talk to your teacher or parents.
exzh: 如果你覺得難過，隨時都可以跟老師或父母聊聊。
note: 同義：talk with

en: Tom thanked Lisa for helping him with his English homework.
exzh: Tom 謝謝 Lisa 幫他做英文作業。
note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing

en: These days, many students use their phones to look up new words.
exzh: 最近，許多學生用手機查生字。
note: 常搭配現在式或現在進行式；比較 in those days 當時

en: Ben is thinking about joining the guitar club this semester.
exzh: Ben 正在考慮這學期加入吉他社。
note: think of 想出、想起

en: Please turn off the lights and the fan before you leave the classroom.
exzh: 離開教室前請把燈和電扇關掉。
note: 反義：turn on

en: Amy waited for her friends at the train station for twenty minutes.
exzh: Amy 在火車站等她的朋友等了二十分鐘。
note: wait for sb. to V 等某人做某事

en: I don't want pizza for lunch. What about beef noodles instead?
exzh: 我午餐不想吃披薩。改吃牛肉麵怎麼樣？
note: 同義：how about；後接名詞或 V-ing

en: Kevin always writes down new English words in a small notebook.
exzh: Kevin 總是把新的英文單字記在一本小筆記本裡。
note: 代名詞放中間：write it down

en: Mia is afraid of dogs, so she never goes near them.
exzh: Mia 怕狗，所以她從不靠近牠們。
note: 後接名詞或 V-ing；同義：be scared of

en: On Friday nights, the night market is full of students and families.
exzh: 每到星期五晚上，夜市裡擠滿了學生和家庭。
note: 同義：be filled with

en: Ken is good at math, so his classmates often ask him for help.
exzh: Ken 擅長數學，所以同學們常向他求助。
note: 反義：be poor at／be bad at

en: Emma missed the bus and was late for school again today.
exzh: Emma 錯過了公車，今天上學又遲到了。
note: 反義：be on time for 準時

en: Tom got off the bus one stop early to buy breakfast.
exzh: Tom 提早一站下公車去買早餐。
note: 反義：get on；下汽車用 get out of

en: It looks like rain, so you had better take an umbrella with you.
exzh: 看起來要下雨了，所以你最好帶把傘。
note: 後接原形動詞；否定 had better not

en: How about going to the movies with us after the exam on Friday?
exzh: 星期五考完試後跟我們一起去看電影怎麼樣？
note: 同義：what about；後接名詞或 V-ing

en: Leo likes to listen to music on his phone while he does homework.
exzh: Leo 喜歡一邊寫作業一邊用手機聽音樂。
note: 比較：hear 聽到（不一定專心）

en: Lisa made a mistake on the last question of the science test.
exzh: Lisa 在自然考試的最後一題犯了錯。
note: 複數 make mistakes；by mistake 不小心

en: The convenience store is right next to our school's front gate.
exzh: 便利商店就在我們學校正門旁邊。
note: 同義：beside

en: Amy goes to the library every day to prepare for the big exam.
exzh: Amy 每天去圖書館準備這場大考。
note: be prepared for 對⋯⋯有準備

en: It was cold outside, so Ben put on his jacket before he left.
exzh: 外面很冷，所以 Ben 出門前穿上了外套。
note: put on 指穿上的動作；wear 指穿著的狀態；反義 take off

en: Mia asked a stranger to take a picture of her family at the lake.
exzh: Mia 請一位陌生人在湖邊幫她全家拍照。
note: 拍⋯⋯的照片：take a picture of；同義 take a photo

en: Kevin turned on the air conditioner because the room was so hot.
exzh: 房間太熱了，所以 Kevin 打開了冷氣。
note: 反義：turn off

en: Emma would like to visit Japan with her best friend next summer.
exzh: Emma 明年夏天想和她最好的朋友去日本玩。
note: 比 want to 更客氣；常縮寫 I'd like to
